reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly flags in Liquidate.executeLiquidate that collateralRemainderCap is computed as mulDivDown(debtInCollateralToken, crLiquidation, PERCENT) instead of using only the excess above debt, i.e., (crLiquidation - PERCENT) * debt. It explains that this overcharges overdue but solvent borrowers and matches the same code path, mechanism, and fix (change to crLiquidation - PERCENT) described in the vulnerability. Differences in severity labeling do not affect that it’s the same issue.
